sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk about certain sounds and noises that.
sentences.tc: 今天我想談談某些聲音和噪音。

sentences.en: We hear every day. There are certain sounds and specific noises that make me feel irritated.
sentences.tc: 我們每天都會聽到。有些聲音和特定的噪音會讓我感到惱火。

sentences.en: They completely irritate me and ruin my mood. like my happy mood, maybe my joyful mood, maybe my peaceful mood. if.
sentences.tc: 他們完全激怒了我，破壞了我的心情。喜歡我快樂的心情，也許是我愉悅的心情，也許是我平靜的心情。如果。

sentences.en: I get irritated from a noise. But there are certain or specific sounds that are very soothing to me. Soothing calm sounds, gentle sounds like rain falling on a tin roof.
sentences.tc: 我對噪音感到惱火。但有些特定的聲音對我來說非常舒緩。舒緩平靜的聲音，溫柔的聲音，就像雨落在鐵皮屋頂上。

sentences.en: The waves crashing onto the shore. Or the sound of being underwater. in the ocean.
sentences.tc: 海浪拍打著海岸。或是水下的聲音。在海洋中。

sentences.en: Where you can hear the crackling corals and the small bubbles popping underwater?
sentences.tc: 哪裡可以聽到水下珊瑚的劈啪聲和小氣泡的破裂聲？

sentences.en: I love the sound of the crackling bubbles in the ocean. or the sound of the breeze on a windy day. The breeze and the chills.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡大海中氣泡破裂的聲音。或大風天的微風聲。微風和寒意。

sentences.en: I like hearing how the wind whooes and blows. The whooes and blows are very soothing to hear.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡聽著風呼嘯而過的聲音。嘶嘶聲和打擊聲聽起來非常舒緩。

sentences.en: I like how the wind sways the trees. The wind blows and the trees sway back and forth. The wind can even create a new song, a beautiful song with the wind.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡風吹動樹木的樣子。風吹過，樹木前後搖曳。風甚至可以創作一首新歌，一首優美的歌與風一起。

sentences.en: Chimes. The windchimes creating soft and calming beautiful music.
sentences.tc: 編鐘。風鈴發出輕柔而平靜的美妙音樂。

sentences.en: I love taking naps outside. where I can hear the birds chirping.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡在外面小睡。在那裡我可以聽到鳥兒的鳴叫聲。

sentences.en: I can hear the wind chimes dangling and making music. And I can hear the breeze and the trees all creating a harmonious, beautiful sound.
sentences.tc: 我聽到風鈴晃來晃去，發出音樂聲。我可以聽到微風和樹木發出和諧、美麗的聲音。

sentences.en: I love the peaceful, soothing sounds of nature.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡寧靜、舒緩的大自然之聲。

sentences.en: I love taking naps in a hammock outside where you can hear all of these sounds while trying to fall asleep. Any water sounds in general for me are very soothing.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡在外面的吊床上小睡，在那裡你可以在嘗試入睡時聽到所有這些聲音。一般來說，任何水聲對我來說都非常舒緩。

sentences.en: Very peaceful to listen to water sounds while just laying down. Some trickling water sounds give me goosebumps. The trickling water falling from one end to the other. It gives me chills.
sentences.tc: 躺下時聽水聲非常平靜。一些滴水聲讓我起雞皮疙瘩。滴滴答答的水從一端流到另一端。這讓我不寒而慄。

sentences.en: All down my spine.
sentences.tc: 都順著我的脊椎下去了。

sentences.en: I get goosebumps or chills if I hear something too close to my ear. Subtle sounds give me the chills. A subtle sound is something very gentle and not very noticeable.
sentences.tc: 如果聽到離耳朵太近的聲音，我會起雞皮疙瘩或發冷。微妙的聲音讓我不寒而慄。微妙的聲音是指非常輕柔且不易察覺的聲音。

sentences.en: Subtle. What sounds give you goosebumps or chills?
sentences.tc: 微妙的。什麼聲音會讓你起雞皮疙瘩或發冷？

sentences.en: Are there any sounds that remind you of a certain person or service?
sentences.tc: 有沒有任何聲音讓您想起某個人或某項服務？

sentences.en: For example, when I hear certain bells or whistles,.
sentences.tc: 例如，當我聽到某些鈴聲或口哨聲時。

sentences.en: They remind me of street vendors. Street vendors that go around and sell things in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 他們讓我想起街頭小販。在墨西哥到處賣東西的街頭小販。

sentences.en: They could be selling food or toys or a service. There is this one street vendor in Mexico that goes around and blows a whistle. Every time.
sentences.tc: 他們可能正在銷售食品、玩具或服務。墨西哥有個街頭小販，到處吹口哨。每次。

sentences.en: He comes around,.
sentences.tc: 他過來了，。
